en.hubeali:
Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Al Amraky Bin Ali, 
(It has been narrated) from Ali son of Ja’far<sup style="font-weight: normal">asws</sup>, from his brother<sup style="font-weight: normal">asws</sup> Abu Al-Hassan<sup style="font-weight: normal">asws</sup>, said, ‘

I asked him<sup style="font-weight: normal">asws</sup> about the speckled crows. And the black ones, is it to eat these two?’ So he<sup style="font-weight: normal">asws</sup> said: ‘It is not Permissible to anything from the crows, ravens and others’.
en.sarwar: 8. Muhammad ibn Yahya has narrated from al-‘Amrakiy ibn Ali from Ali ibn Ja‘far from his brother abu al-Hassan, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, who has said the following:
“I once asked abu al-Hassan, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, about using crows of several colors and black ones, for food. He (the Imam) said, ‘None of the crows are lawful for food, zagh or others.’”
